## Definition of done

- [ ] Tests written from the acceptance criteria first
- [ ] Lint, type checks, tests and the governance check pass; no test weakened
- [ ] No secrets or real personal data in the change
- [ ] Screens follow their spec and the design system, and pass the accessibility checks
- [ ] User-facing text is honest
- [ ] Evidence recorded for each criterion
- [ ] Handoff done (short close comments here; a full handoff closes this or hands it on)
